text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the efforts of Hokko Tarumae and 
the others, the hot spring town began 
bustling with more life than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Male Customer
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that's a fine hot spring. Where 
should I soak next, I wonder.

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Female Customer
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. You're getting on in years, so 
don't get too greedy and let the hot water 
go to your head.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...There's something that's been bothering 
me a little.

text_block_list.name: Souvenir Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Aaah. Now that Tarumae-chan mentions it, I 
do feel like there are quite a lot of 
older customers.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
So, as expected... there is a bias in the 
customer demographic.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Racing staff and Umamusume do come. There 
are plenty of older folks, too. It's 
just... there aren't many young, casual 
customers, are there?

text_block_list.name: Souvenir Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Still, though. There're plenty of 
customers anyway, so isn't it fine not to 
worry about it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...I think it's fine for now. But—if it's 
not embraced by a wider audience, I worry 
it won't last long."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Take the Twinkle Series, for instance. I 
think the reason it continues today is 
precisely because people of all ages and 
genders can enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I want this hot spring to be like that, 
too—a place that anyone can enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Let me think about it for a bit. To 
see if there's a good way."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *yaaawn*...
choice_data_list: …Are you okay? You look sleepy, though.
…Are you okay? You look sleepy, though.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I've been racking my brain for a 
breakthrough, ...but nothing's really 
coming to mind."
choice_data_list: You should rest for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Seems like I'm just repeating the 
same thing over and over. I'm hopeless, 
aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “Still... I just can't leave it alone.”

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
The history of the hot springs resort――and 
the feelings of the people living here. 
Now that I've touched upon them, I want to 
help out to the absolute fullest.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —I'm fine. I won't push myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...What should we do? A strategy that 
could broaden our audience and entertain 
people of all ages...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just like in the Twinkle Series. ...Which 
means—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—A live event featuring Umamusume, you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even this hot spring town originally 
flourished thanks to Umamusume. I 
suggested that if we could ask the girls 
who frequently visit here to gather...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed...! If active Umamusume could hold 
a massive live show, it'd become a hot 
topic and draw in people of all ages!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but for a major live performance, 
preparing the equipment and securing a 
venue will inevitably—

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. Leave that kind of hassle to our 
busybody selves.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Everyone?! When did you—

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sounded like an interesting 
conversation. I can easily arrange a venue 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Voices of Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Also, when it comes to the equipment, 
would you mind leaving that to us?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: !? That voice... Everyone from Tomakomai?!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it says that whenever you're in 
trouble, Lady Tarumae, she wants you to 
reach out anytime~.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Residents
text_block_list.text:
“We've got a full set of equipment for 
town revitalization, you know. We can 
bring it over to you right away!”
choice_data_list:
Leave negotiating with the performing 
Umamusume to me!

Leave negotiating with the performing 
Umamusume to me!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Well, long story short, everyone just 
wants to help you out, you see.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Why not give it a shot? Let's see just how 
much we can accomplish when we all put our 
strength together.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And—thanks to everyone's efforts, the 
concert was held, and the seats were 
filled with an ecstatic crowd of all ages.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! When the rejuvenating powers of 
a hot spring are bestowed upon my flawless 
self, my beauty becomes truly infinite!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Having gained vitality from these hot 
springs ourselves— I wish to return that 
energy from the stage today.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Once you're finished, be sure to take your 
time and enjoy the hot springs! Now 
then—start♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you all so very much. It's thanks 
to everyone that today's event was such a 
success.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you know it! After all, we ain't 
about to lose to Tarumae-chan either!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? What do you mean I haven't lost?

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
It's what you'd call love for one's 
hometown. Whether in prosperous times or 
when it declined, I've lived here the 
whole time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tomakomai Resident A
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. Just like Tarumae-chan, all 
of us love our hometowns to bits.

text_block_list.name: Local Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"If it's for the sake of protecting that, 
you'll always lend a helping hand, right?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu. Right now, I feel so happy. It 
feels like my two hometowns have finally 
connected."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All right! Let's keep sharing the wonders 
of our hometown with everyone!
